newsitem.title: USA: Cell Robotics seeks FDA laser approval.
newsitem.headline: Cell Robotics seeks FDA laser approval.

text.p: Cell Robotics International Inc said Wednesday it had submitted an application to the Food and Drug Administration to get approval to market its erbium skin resurfacing laser.
The company said its laser did not damage skin as much as carbon dioxide lasers being used for skin resurfacing and other cosmetic applications.
It said it had completed a first-generation prototype for the erbium skin resurfacing laser with plans to introduce it into the market by mid-1997.
"Additional lasers for other aesthetic applications such as hair removal and tattoo removal may be added to the product line," it said.
Cell Robotics International develops, manufactures and markets several medical and research laser devices and associated products.
